strings.pageTitle: LabelFit India — read the label, your way
strings.heroEyebrow: PACKAGED FOOD LABELS, MADE EASIER TO READ
strings.heroLede: Photograph a package to see its stated age range, ingredients, allergen statement, nutrition, and preparation or storage text. Each readout comes with a snippet from the photo; unclear text is flagged.
strings.boundaryText: Review the package wording beside every extracted detail.
strings.cardBody: Start with one clear photo of the ingredients or information panel.
strings.dropOr: Drag a clear photo here, or
strings.dropSmall: JPG, PNG or WebP · crop a panel for a closer read
strings.tipBody: Use good light and keep text in focus. Crop to one panel if the label is small in the photo.
strings.cropHelp: Drag over the label area. The selected crop keeps the source photo’s detail.
strings.apiNotConfigured: Gemini is not configured on this server yet.
strings.apiUnavailable: LabelFit server is unavailable. Start it with npm start.
strings.consent: I understand the photo is sent to Gemini. I checked it shows only the package, with no people or personal details.
strings.privacyCopy: Unpaid Gemini API content may be used to improve Google services and may be reviewed by people. Do not send personal or confidential information. The app does not save the photo; store:false is not a zero-retention promise.
strings.resultsEmptyTitle: Review the readout beside the package photo.
strings.resultsEmptyBody: Missing or uncertain wording is marked so you can check the package.
strings.loadingBody: Checking the visible text in your photo.
strings.scopeText: LabelFit reports candidate transcriptions with model-provided snippets. It does not issue food-safety verdicts, diagnose, interpret allergy risk, or tell caregivers what to feed. Small, curved, or blurry print can be misread, so compare every readout with the package.
strings.noText: No text found in the photo.
strings.reminder: Compare the readout with the package. The status is a model read, not an accuracy score.
strings.errChoose: Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP label photo under 30 MB. Large photos are resized automatically.
strings.errRead: Could not read that file. Choose the photo again.
strings.errLoad: Could not read that photo. Try a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
strings.errTooLarge: This photo is still too large after resizing. Try a closer photo of one label panel.
strings.errServer: The LabelFit server could not read this photo (error {status}). Please try again.
strings.errTimeout: The label read timed out. Crop to one panel or retake the photo with text in focus, then try again.
strings.errNetwork: Could not reach the LabelFit server. Check that it is running and try again.
strings.draftBanner: Draft translation: not yet reviewed by a native speaker. Do not rely on it.
